title: Clerk Yue Sia-Pah Of Special Branch S.5 Suspected Of Complicity In Armed Robbery Released By French Police On 4.1.41

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 5, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY File No. S.B./327 Date. Jan. 7 / 41）

Subject (in full)........................................Clerk Yue Siao-pah of Special Branch S. 5 suspected of complicity in armed robbery released by French Police on 4.1.41.

Made by......D. S. Pharazyn....................Forwarded by.........Supt. Mason

Third Class Clerk Yue Siao-pah ( 于孝伯 ) of this Section, who was taken into custody by the French Police on August 25, 1940, on suspicion of complicity in an armed robbery (see file N-327 attached), was released by the French Police on January 4, 1941, following a judgment delivered by the Shanghai 2nd Special District Court on December 31, 1940, to the effect that Yue Siao-pah was found not guilty owing to lack of evidence.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）
(Special Branch).

D. S. Pharazyn
D. S.

主题（全称）........................................特别分部 S. 5 职员于孝伯涉嫌参与持械抢劫案，于1941年1月4日被法租界巡捕房释放。

制作人......D. S. Pharazyn....................转呈人.........梅森警司 (Supt. Mason)

本组三等职员于孝伯 ( Yu Siao-pah ) 于1940年8月25日因涉嫌参与持械抢劫案被法租界巡捕房拘留（参见附件档案 N-327），后于1941年1月4日获法租界巡捕房释放，此前上海第二特区地方法院于1940年12月31日作出判决，认定因证据不足，于孝伯无罪。

August 30, 1940
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. BR. REGISTRY 327 ... 9 / 12 / ...）
Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao, National Herald,
China Evening News :-

"DISMISSED CONSTABLE IMPLICATED IN ROBBERY OF GOLD BARS."

On July 17, Wong Tse-zung (          ),
native of Shantung, residing at No. 35 Heng Mou Li, Boulevard
de Montigny, was robbed of 28 bars of gold valued at more
than $140,000.    The complainant reported the case to the
French Police and all the gold-smiths were later notified.
The Police subsequently ascertained that the
Lou Tien Pao gold-smith shop (          ) on Robinson
Road had received some of the stolen gold bars.    A man
named Wong Ping-kung (          ) was arrested and charged
before the 2nd Shanghai Special District Court.
During the period of remand, nine other
suspects were arrested, namely, Tseu Ah-kung (          ),
age 28, native of Kompo, Wai Ching-fang (          ), age 31,
native of Yenchen, Sung Ching-foh (          ), age 23,
native of Kompo, Hsu Yih-san (          ), age 39, native of
Haichow, Li Zau-tsong (          ), age 27, native of
Tientsin (formerly C.P.C. 619 of the Municipal Police of the
International Settlement), Yu Siao-pah (          ), age 34,
native of Tientsin, (a clerk in the Special Branch, Section 5,
of the International Settlement, residing at No. 34 Heng Mou
Li, Boulevard de Montigny), Wong Ts-fong (          ), age 33,
native of Hwaian and Li Ah-lung (          ), alias Tsang
Foh-liang (          ), age 25, native of Kompo.    Another
man named Tsung Zang-zung (          ), age 32, native of
Canton, a textile shroff, residing at No. 1 Li Oo Li, Rue
Admirale Bayle, was arrested for receiving stolen property.

1940年8月30日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别分部 登记室 327 ... 1940年12月9日 ...）
《中美日报》、《申报》、《新闻报》、
《中华晚报》：

“被革职巡捕涉嫌金条抢劫案。”

1940年7月17日，山东籍人士王治仁 ( Wong Tse-zung )，住蒙自路恒茂里35号，遭抢劫金条28根，价值超过14万美元。报案人向法租界巡捕房报案，随后通知了所有银楼。警方随后查明，罗宾森路的老天宝银楼 ( Lou Tien Pao ) 接收了部分被盗金条。一名叫王炳根 ( Wong Ping-kung ) 的男子被捕，并在上海第二特区地方法院被起诉。
在还押候审期间，另有九名嫌疑人被捕，分别是：周阿根 ( Tseu Ah-kung )，28岁，高邮人；还庆芳 ( Wai Ching-fang )，31岁，盐城人；孙之福 ( Sung Ching-foh )，23岁，高邮人；许益山 ( Hsu Yih-san )，39岁，海州人；吕兆昌 ( Li Zau-tsong )，27岁，天津人（原国际租界工部局警务处华捕第619号）；于孝伯 ( Yu Siao-pah )，34岁，天津人（国际租界特别分部第五科职员，住蒙自路恒茂里34号）；王志方 ( Wong Ts-fong )，33岁，淮安人；以及李阿龙 ( Li Ah-lung )，别名张国梁 ( Tsang Foh-liang )，25岁，高邮人。另一名男子曾南仁 ( Tsung Zang-zung )，32岁，广东人，纺织业钱庄职员，住贝勒路李欧里1号，因收受赃物被捕。

page_data.en:
-2-
Some of these suspects stated that the
robbery was carried out on information given by Yu Siao-pah
and that the firearms were supplied by Li Lau-tsong. The
stolen gold bars have been disposed of. Two gold bars
(10 oz. each) were recovered from Yu's home, one bar was
found in Li's home and two others in Tsung Lau-zung's home.
One pistol was found in Sung Ching-foh's home.
All the prisoners were charged on the
morning of August 29 before the 2nd Shanghai Special
District Court along with the prisoner Wong Ping-kung.
The French Police Advocate Yao Lau-dee
( ) informed the Court that the police had not
yet completed their investigations and asked for a
remand.
Judge Li remanded the case and ordered that
the prisoners be detained in Police custody.
page_data.zh:
-2-
部分嫌疑人供称，抢劫行动是根据于孝伯提供的情报实施的，枪支由李老松 ( Li Lau-tsong ) 提供。被盗金条已被处置。在于孝伯家中搜出两根金条（每根10盎司），在李老松家中搜出一根，在曾老松 ( Tsung Lau-zung ) 家中搜出另外两根。在孙之福家中搜出一支手枪。
所有囚犯连同囚犯王炳根于8月29日上午在上海第二特区地方法院被起诉。
法租界巡捕房检察官姚肇第 ( Yao Lau-dee ) 告知法庭，警方调查尚未完成，并申请延期审理。
李法官批准延期审理，并命令将囚犯羁押于巡捕房看守所。

China Evening News of September 18, 1940; Sin Wan Pao,
Shun Pao, National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News
of September 19, 1940:-

THE GOLD BARS ROBBERY CASE STATEMENTS OF ACCUSED IN COURT

On July 17, Wong Tse-zung(王治仁), native of
Shantung, residing at No. 25 Hang Mou Li, Boulevard de
Montigny, was robbed of 28 bars of gold valued at more
than $150,000. The complainant reported the case to the
French Police and a close investigation was started by
detectives Chang Tung-chen(張東成) and Dao Yung-ling
(陶永麟). Later 10 men, namely, Wong Ping-kung(王炳根),
Tseu Ah-kung(周阿根), Sung Ching-foh(孫慶福), Wai Ching-
fang(還慶芳), Hsu Yih-san(許益山), Li Zau-tsong(呂兆昌),
Yu Siao-pah(于孝伯), Wong Ts-fong(王志方), Tsang Koh-
liang(張國樑) alias Li Ah-lung(李阿龍) and Tsung Zang-
zung(曾南仁) were arrested, and were charged before the
Shanghai Second Special District Court. The case was
remanded, because the French Police had not yet completed
their investigations.

This morning the accused were again taken before
the Shanghai Second Special District Court.

The French Police Advocate Yuan Kya-huang(袁家潢)
informed the Judge that the Police were charging the first
nine accused with robbery and the last accused with receiving
stolen property.

The investigating detective Chang Tung-chen gave
the following evidence:- "The case occurred on July 17.
On July 20, the French Police notified all the gold-smiths.
On July 17, Wong Ping-kung received three stolen gold bars
and on July/23 he received two more. Taking advantage of the fact
that the source of the stolen property was unknown, Wong
bought it at a cheap price. The other accused are the men

1940年9月18日《中华晚报》；1940年9月19日《新晚报》、
《申报》、《新闻报》、《中美日报》：

金条抢劫案 被告在庭上的供词

1940年7月17日，山东籍人士王治仁 ( Wong Tse-zung )，住蒙自路恒茂里25号，遭抢劫金条28根，价值超过15万美元。报案人向法租界巡捕房报案，侦探张东成 ( Chang Tung-chen ) 和陶永麟 ( Dao Yung-ling ) 随即展开严密调查。随后，王炳根 ( Wong Ping-kung )、周阿根 ( Tseu Ah-kung )、孙之福 ( Sung Ching-foh )、还庆芳 ( Wai Ching-fang )、许益山 ( Hsu Yih-san )、吕兆昌 ( Li Zau-tsong )、于孝伯 ( Yu Siao-pah )、王志方 ( Wong Ts-fong )、张国梁 ( Tsang Koh-liang ) 别名李阿龙 ( Li Ah-lung ) 以及曾南仁 ( Tsung Zang-zung ) 等十人被捕，并在上海第二特区地方法院被起诉。由于法租界巡捕房尚未完成调查，案件被延期审理。

今天上午，被告再次被提解至上海第二特区地方法院。

法租界巡捕房检察官袁家潢 ( Yuan Kya-huang ) 告知法官，警方指控前九名被告犯有抢劫罪，最后一名被告犯有收受赃物罪。

负责调查的侦探张东成提供如下证词：“案发于7月17日。7月20日，法租界巡捕房通知了所有银楼。7月17日，王炳根收到三根被盗金条，7月23日又收到两根。王炳根利用赃物来源不明的情况，以低价收购。其他被告是实际

（印：... 登记室 ... 1940年9月24日）

page_data.en:
-2-
who had actually committed the robbery or who had
assisted in the robbery or who had received
stolen property and all must be severely punished."
Wong Ping-kung stated, "I am an accountant
of the Lou Tien Pao gold-smith shop(老天寶銀樓)
with a monthly pay of $30. On July 17, two men came
to my shop to offer a gold bar for sale. I estimated
the value at $4,120. Later, another man came with
two gold bars for sale valued at more than $9,000,
On July 23, we received two more gold bars. We did
not know that all these gold bars were stolen property."
Tsu Ah-kung stated, "The robbery was carried
on information given by Chang Ah-sz(張阿四) and Peng
Tuh-hai(彭德海). Those who took part in the robbery
were Wai Ching-fang, Sung Ching-foh, Tsang Koh-liang,
Chang Ah-sz and myself. In all, 28 gold bars were
taken away. My share was one gold bar."
Wai Ching-fang stated, "Sung Ching-foh entered
the complainant's home first. Sung Ching-foh, Chang
Ah-sz and I each had a pistol which afterwards were taken
away by Chang Ah-sz."
Chang Ah-sz stated that they obtained in all
25 gold bars, and he received one as his share.
Sung Ching-foh stated, "On that day I did not
know that they were going to rob gold bars; all I knew
was that they asked me to help them. On reaching the
complainant's home, I had to follow them. Afterwards
I received a gold bar which was disposed of by a
fellow countryman who gave me $3,000."
Hsu Yih-san stated, "I did not go to the
complainant's home on that day. Tsang Koh-liang wanted
to organize a special corps in Chapei but he lacked arms,
so he borrowed my pistol. Afterwards they gave me a gold
bar."
page_data.zh:
-2-
实施抢劫、协助抢劫或收受赃物的人，均应受到严惩。”
王炳根陈述道：“我是老天宝银楼 ( Lou Tien Pao gold-smith shop ) 的会计，月薪30美元。7月17日，两名男子来到我的店中出售一根金条。我估价约为4,120美元。后来，另一名男子带着两根金条来出售，价值超过9,000美元。7月23日，我们又收到两根金条。我们不知道这些金条全是赃物。”
周阿根陈述道：“抢劫行动是根据张阿四 ( Chang Ah-sz ) 和彭德海 ( Peng Tuh-hai ) 提供的情报实施的。参与抢劫的有还庆芳、孙之福、张国梁、张阿四和我本人。总共抢走了28根金条。我分得了一根金条。”
还庆芳陈述道：“孙之福首先进入报案人家中。孙之福、张阿四和我各持有一支手枪，后来被张阿四拿走。”
张阿四陈述道，他们总共获得25根金条，他分得一根作为份额。
孙之福陈述道：“那天我不知道他们要去抢劫金条；我只知道他们让我去帮忙。到达报案人家中后，我只能跟着他们。后来我得到一根金条，由一名同乡处理掉，给了我3,000美元。”
许益山陈述道：“那天我没有去报案人家中。张国梁想在闸北组织一支特别队伍，但缺乏武器，所以借了我的手枪。后来他们给了我一根金条。”

page_data.en:
-3-

Tsang Koh-liang stated, "Chang Ah-sz entered
the complainant's home first, Sung Ching-foh second,
Ts-u Ah-kung third, Wai Ching-fang fourth, and I was
the fifth. We seized some gold bars. I received one
as my share."

Li Zau-tsong stated, "I was formerly C.P.C.
No. 619 in the Shanghai Municipal Police. I was
suspended by the Police Force for six months, because
I was robbed of my pistol in Zaukatu while on duty.
The period of suspension is nearly over and I am
preparing to resume duty, but I became implicated in
this case, so I cannot resume duty. I know nothing
about the case."

Yu Siao-pah stated, "I am a clerk in the
Special Branch, Section 5, of the Shanghai Municipal
Police. I am a relative of the complainant Wong Tse-
zung. Although I resided at Hong Mou Li close to the
complainant's home, I did not know that Wong was in
possession of gold bars. I really know nothing about
the robbery."

Wong Ts-fong stated, "I did not go there on
that day. I do not know Chang Ah-sz. I know nothing
about the robbery."

Tsung Zang-zung stated, "I am a textile shroff.
The two gold bars which were seized in my home belong to
my countryman Kao Chin-zung(高金顺). They are not
my property. I know Kao Ching-zung, because he had asked
me to apply for a gambling den licence, as he wanted to
open a gambling den. Please excuse me and find me not
guilty."
page_data.zh:
-3-

张国梁陈述道：“张阿四首先进入报案人家中，孙之福第二个，周阿根第三个，还庆芳第四个，我是第五个。我们夺取了一些金条。我分得一根作为份额。”

吕兆昌陈述道：“我原是上海工部局警务处华捕第619号。因为在乍浦路执勤时手枪被抢，我被警队停职六个月。停职期即将结束，我正准备复职，但因卷入此案，无法复职。我对本案一无所知。”

于孝伯陈述道：“我是上海工部局警务处特别分部第五科的职员。我是报案人王治仁的亲戚。虽然我住在离报案人家很近的恒茂里，但我不知道王治仁持有金条。我真的对抢劫案一无所知。”

王志方陈述道：“那天我没去那里。我不认识张阿四。我对抢劫案一无所知。”

曾南仁陈述道：“我是纺织业钱庄职员。在我家中搜出的两根金条属于我的同乡高金顺 ( Kao Chin-zung )。它们不是我的财产。我认识高金顺，因为他想开设赌场，曾委托我申请赌场执照。请原谅我，判我无罪。”

page_data.en:
-4-
All the accused have retained lawyers Wu Tsoo-
liang (吳楚梁), Wong Sz-tsoong(王士宗) and Huang
Tsung-gi(黃曾杰) for their defence.
Judge Li Vee-zeu(李惟善) remanded the case to
9 a.m. September 26, as the case is a very complicated
one.
All the accused were detained in custody.
page_data.zh:
-4-
所有被告均聘请律师吴楚梁 ( Wu Tsoo-liang )、王士宗 ( Wong Sz-tsoong ) 和黄曾杰 ( Huang Tsung-gi ) 为其辩护。
鉴于案情非常复杂，李惟善 ( Li Vee-zeu ) 法官将案件延期至9月26日上午9时审理。
所有被告均被羁押。

Assistance to French Police in recovering stolen property -
Two gold bars (each weighing 10 taels).
D.S.I. Tao Aeng Yong Officer i/ch.

Sir,
With reference to the remarks of D.D.O. "B"
regarding the disposal of the two persons, D.S.I.
Lee of the French Police, who is on this case, was
kept in touch and the following information was
secured.
On the morning of 28-8-40 they were taken before
the Shanghai 2nd Special Area District Court, and
were placed under Writ of Detention for a period of
three weeks. As a result of their investigation during
the period of detention a charge of Armed Robbery has
been preferred by the French Police against the two
men and others. The case will be heard on the
morning of 17-9-40 and result of the trial will be
submitted in due course.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Tao Aeng Yong
D.S.I.

《中华晚报》：

“被革职巡捕涉嫌金条抢劫案。”

1940年7月17日，山东籍人士王治仁 ( Wong Tse-zung )，住蒙自路恒茂里35号，遭抢劫金条28根，价值超过14万美元。报案人向法租界巡捕房报案，随后通知了所有银楼。警方随后查明，罗宾森路的老天宝银楼 ( Lou Tien Pao ) 接收了部分被盗金条。一名叫王炳根 ( Wong Ping-kung ) 的男子被捕，并在上海第二特区地方法院被起诉。
在还押候审期间，另有九名嫌疑人被捕，分别是：周阿根 ( Tseu Ah-kung )，28岁，高邮人；还庆芳 ( Wai Ching-fang )，31岁，盐城人；孙之福 ( Sung Ching-foh )，28岁，高邮人；许益山 ( Hsu Yih-san )，39岁，海州人；吕兆昌 ( Li Zau-tsong )，27岁，天津人（原国际租界工部局警务处华捕第619号 [原文为C.F.C.]）；于孝伯 ( Yu Siao-pah )，34岁，天津人（国际租界特别分部第五科职员，住蒙自路恒茂里34号）；王志芳 ( Wong Ts-fong )，33岁，淮安人；以及李阿龙 ( Li Ah-lung )，别名张国良 ( Tsang Koh-liang )，25岁，高邮人。另一名男子曾尚仁 ( Tsung Lang-zung )，32岁，广东人，纺织业钱庄职员，住贝勒路李欧里1号，因收受赃物被捕。

page_data.en:
-2-
Some of these suspects stated that the
robbery was carried out on information given by Yu Siao-pah
and that the firearms were supplied by Li Lau-tsong. The
stolen gold bars have been disposed of. Two gold bars
(10 oz. each) were recovered from Yu's home, one bar was
found in Li's home and two others in Tsung Lau-zung's home.
One pistol was found in Sung Ching-foh's home.
All the prisoners were charged on the
morning of August 29 before the 2nd Shanghai Special
District Court along with the prisoner Wong Ping-kung.
The French Police Advocate Yao Zau-dee
(姚肇第) informed the Court that the police had not
yet completed their investigations and asked for a
remand.
Judge Li remanded the case and ordered that
the prisoners be detained in Police custody.
page_data.zh:
-2-
部分嫌疑人供称，抢劫行动是根据于孝伯提供的情报实施的，枪支由李老松 ( Li Lau-tsong ) 提供。被盗金条已被处置。在于孝伯家中搜出两根金条（每根10盎司），在李老松家中搜出一根，在曾老松 ( Tsung Lau-zung ) 家中搜出另外两根。在孙之福家中搜出一支手枪。
所有囚犯连同囚犯王炳根于8月29日上午在上海第二特区地方法院被起诉。
法租界巡捕房检察官姚肇第 ( Yao Zau-dee ) 告知法庭，警方调查尚未完成，并申请延期审理。
李法官批准延期审理，并命令将囚犯羁押于巡捕房看守所。

28/8/1948 /:- 40

Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, National
Herald and Central China Daily News of August 26, 1948

SEVENTEEN ROBBERS OF GOLD BARS ARRESTED

At about 9 a.m. yesterday, officers of the French
Police accompanied by officers of the S.M.P. raided Room
No. 213 of the An Tung Hotel (安東旅館) on Hoopeh Road.
The twelve men in the above room were arrested and a pistol
was seized. It is learned that the twelve men arrested are
robbers.

It will be recalled that on July 16, the home of
Wang Ts-sung (王治仁) on the 1st floor of house No. 35,
Hung Mou Li (恆茂里), Boulevard de Montigny, was entered
by robbers who took away 28 gold bars valued at more than
$145,000. It was later learned by the Police that the
robbers concerned were hiding in the An Tung Hotel and their
arrest was effected yesterday. It is also learned that Kwei
Ching-foong (瞿琴鳳), native of Kompo, a ricsha coolie,
an important figure in the case, was also arrested.

Up to the time of going to press, seventeen robbers
had been apprehended and three gold bars were recovered. The
principal offender is still at large. The investigation is
being continued.

Augy 26/8

1948年8月26日的《中美日报》、《申报》、《新闻报》、《国民新闻》及《华中日报》

十七名金条劫匪被捕

昨日上午9时许，法国警察局的警官在公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）警官的陪同下，突袭了胡倍路（Hoopeh Road）安东旅馆（安東旅館）213号房间。该房间内的十二名男子被逮捕，并缴获手枪一支。据悉，被捕的十二人均为劫匪。

回顾此前，7月16日，位于蒙梯尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）恒茂里（恆茂里）35号一楼的王治仁（Wang Ts-sung）寓所遭劫匪闯入，抢走28根金条，价值超过145,000美元。警方后获悉相关劫匪藏匿于安东旅馆，并于昨日实施逮捕。另悉，本案重要人物、来自高邮（Kompo，音译）的人力车夫瞿琴鳳（Kwei Ching-foong）也被捕。

截至发稿时，已有十七名劫匪落网，追回金条三根。主犯仍在逃。调查正在进行中。

Augy 1948年8月26日
归档
